briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including fact-checking organizations and medical experts, contradict the claim that drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice will destroy the coronavirus. FactCheck.org and AFP Fact Check, both published in April 2020, state there is no scientific evidence that lemon juice, hot water, or their combination can kill the coronavirus or prevent COVID-19 infection. The Cleveland Clinic notes that a study indicated the coronavirus can survive in acidic environments, and consuming lemon water does not significantly change the body's pH level. NDTV Food, in April 2021, and The Guardian, in March 2020, describe this claim as part of widespread misinformation and "quack cures" during the pandemic. While some sources mention warm water with lemon as a general home remedy for hydration, they do not claim it cures or destroys the coronavirus.
